This suggests a potential mechanism where Oblonganoside C may modulate SBK1 activity, which in turn influences the gamma-2 subunit of the GABA receptor. The evidence indicates a direct or indirect relationship between Oblonganoside C and the GABA receptor subunit, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for Oblonganoside C in regulating GABA receptor function, potentially through the activation or inhibition of SBK1. The observed scores suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct involvement of Oblonganoside C in the modulation of the gamma-2 subunit.
